subject: What's the condition to use in the conditionalPanel to show the objects after a file is uploaded?

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: What's the condition to use in the conditionalPanel to show the objects after a file is uploaded?
parts:
In my ui.R I have code like

...
 fileInput('file1', 'Choose a CSV File to Upload',
              accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain,csv','csv')
) #for input files
    ,conditionalPanel(
condition = "output.finishedUploading"
, actionButton("importDataButton","Import Data")
)
...

After trying a few things I still couldn't get the action buttion to show after uploading a file. The last thing I tried was like this in the server.R

...
output$finishedUploading <- reactive({
if (is.null(input$file1))
0
else
1
})
...

Help.

PS The fileInput doesn't show .csv files in my Windows  set up? Is my accept = correct? Might start another topic on this.

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: What's the condition to use in the conditionalPanel to show the objects after a file is uploaded?
parts:
Hi, 

 Type  outputOptions(output, 'finishedUploading', suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)  just after you define  output$finishedUploading. This allows  condition="output.finishedUploading"  to be detected by conditionalPanel().

I had a tabPanel that is working, and I want to wrap a conditionalPanel around it with condition on a variable in server.R. Adding the outputOptions (I found it from several other threads,Thanks Joe) seems to make it work.

I still see a couple of issues, 
1. tab 'Hidden' is not visible when the condition is met, but clicking on the area where it is when it is normally shown does bring up the panel; 
2. when the panel is shown, it also appears in other panels

snippet of code:

in server.R

output.myReactiveVariable<-renderText({
  myDataFrame() %>% filter(x==myX()) %>% select(z)
})
outputOptions(output, 'myReactiveVariable', suspendWhenHidden=FALSE) 
  

in ui.R

tabPanel(
......
),
conditionalPanel(
  condition = "output.myReactiveVariable== 'special'",
tabPanel( 
  'Hidden', 
  sidebarLayout( 
    
    sidebarPanel(("Select A Request"),
                     
                 uiOutput("selectRequestForEditTab"),
                 actionButton("editRequestInfo","Edit it")),
    
    mainPanel(h4("Edit Request Details"),
...
              textOutput("editSuccess")
    )
  )
)
) # end_of_conditional_panel
